name: COPILOT_ALLOW_ALL
description: Set to true to allow all permissions automatically (equivalent to --allow-all).

name: COPILOT_AUTO_UPDATE
description: Set to false to disable automatic updates of the CLI and first-party plugins.

name: COPILOT_CACHE_HOME
description: Override the cache directory (used for marketplace caches, auto-update packages, and other ephemeral data). See GitHub Copilot CLI configuration directory for platform defaults.

name: COPILOT_EDITOR
description: Editor command for interactive editing (checked after $VISUAL and $EDITOR). Defaults to vi if none are set.

name: COPILOT_ENABLE_HTTP2
description: Set to 1 or true to opt into HTTP/2 transport. HTTP/1.1 is the default.

conditions: Availability depends on the documented provider, platform, version, or execution mode.

name: COPILOT_GH_HOST
description: GitHub hostname for Copilot CLI only, overriding GH_HOST. Use when GH_HOST targets GitHub Enterprise Server but Copilot needs to authenticate against GitHub.com or a GitHub Enterprise Cloud hostname.

conditions: when GH_HOST targets GitHub Enterprise Server but Copilot needs to authenticate against GitHub.

name: COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN
description: Authentication token. Takes precedence over GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN.

name: COPILOT_LARGE_OUTPUT_THRESHOLD_BYTES
role: Copilot Large Output Threshold Bytes configuration
description: Maximum UTF-8 byte size for tool output returned directly to the model. Default: 20480 (20 KiB). See Managing context in GitHub Copilot CLI.

name: COPILOT_MCP_TOOL_CACHE
description: Set to false to disable loading and persisting local MCP server tool snapshots for the entire process. See Tool snapshot caching.

name: COPILOT_PLAN_THEN_AUTOPILOT
description: Set to 1, true, yes, or on to request plan-then-autopilot (equivalent to --plan --mode autopilot) for harnesses that can only inject environment variables. Ignored, with a warning, when an explicit --mode, --autopilot, or --plan option is passed. See Plan-then-autopilot.

conditions: when an explicit --mode, --autopilot, or --plan option is passed.

name: COPILOT_PROMPT_FRAME
description: Set to 1 to enable the decorative UI frame around the input prompt, or 0 to disable it. Overrides the PROMPT_FRAME experimental feature flag for the current session.

conditions: Availability depends on the documented provider, platform, version, or execution mode.

name: PLUGINS_DASHBOARD
description: Set to false to disable the plugins dashboard opened by bare /plugin, /mcp, and /skills, and to disable the non-interactive copilot plugin/copilot plugins commands.

name: COPILOT_STRIP_REASONING_ON_RESUME
role: Copilot Strip Reasoning On Resume configuration
description: Set to 0 or false to keep BYOK reasoning tokens across a session resume instead of stripping them. Defaults to stripping them.

name: COPILOT_SUBAGENT_MAX_CONCURRENT
description: Maximum concurrent subagents per session (default: 32, range: 1–256).

name: COPILOT_TASK_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
role: Copilot Task Wait Timeout Seconds configuration
description: Maximum seconds -p (and -p --autopilot) waits for pending background agents or shell commands to finish before exiting (default: 600; 0 exits immediately without waiting).

name: GH_HOST
description: GitHub hostname for both GitHub CLI and Copilot CLI (default: github.com). Set to your GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency hostname. Override with COPILOT_GH_HOST for Copilot CLI only.

name: GH_TOKEN
description: Authentication token. Takes precedence over GITHUB_TOKEN.

name: GITHUB_COPILOT_PROMPT_MODE_EXTENSIONS
role: Github Copilot Prompt Mode Extensions configuration
description: Set to true to load project extensions and allow extension management tools in prompt mode (-p). Disabled by default to prevent running repository-controlled extension code without interactive trust.

name: GITHUB_COPILOT_PROMPT_MODE_REPO_HOOKS
display_name: Github Copilot Prompt Mode Repo Hooks
role: Github Copilot Prompt Mode Repo Hooks configuration
description: Set to true to load repository hooks in prompt mode (-p). Repository hooks also load automatically when the folder is already trusted or COPILOT_ALLOW_ALL is set.

conditions: when the folder is already trusted or COPILOT_ALLOW_ALL is set.

name: GITHUB_COPILOT_PROMPT_MODE_WORKSPACE_MCP
display_name: Github Copilot Prompt Mode Workspace Mcp
role: Github Copilot Prompt Mode Workspace Mcp configuration
description: Set to true to load workspace MCP sources in prompt mode (-p). Disabled by default to prevent starting repository-controlled MCP servers without interactive trust.

name: PLAIN_DIFF
description: Set to true to disable rich diff rendering.

name: USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP
description: Set to false to use the system ripgrep instead of the bundled version.

name: USE_TGREP
description: Set to true to always use tgrep, a trigram-indexed search engine, regardless of repository size, or false to always use ripgrep. When unset, Copilot CLI automatically switches from ripgrep to tgrep once a repository exceeds a platform-specific file-count threshold.

conditions: When unset, Copilot CLI automatically switches from ripgrep to tgrep once a repository exceeds a platform-specific file-count threshold.

name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_PROTOCOL
role: Otel Exporter Otlp Traces Protocol configuration

name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_PROTOCOL
role: Otel Exporter Otlp Metrics Protocol configuration

name: OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT
display_name: Otel Instrumentation Genai Capture Message Content
role: Otel Instrumentation Genai Capture Message Content configuration

name: COPILOT_OTEL_FILE_EXPORTER_PATH
role: Copilot Otel File Exporter Path configuration
